verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents its own registered-agent service: its address is listed as the RA on public records, and it handles the RA-change paperwork and Secretary of State update. Its online ordering flow suggests the service can be bought online. Nothing shows the founder immediately receives the exact agent name and street address to put on their own formation or change filing, and there is no same-day timing claim. missing for 10: same-day delivery of agent name/address at purchase, explicit online RA checkout flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
